title: Add bootstrap scripts

context.summary: Add cross-platform bootstrap entrypoints that fetch or use a release bundle and launch the installer.
context.background: The installer core and wizard exist. Users now need install.sh and install.ps1 wrappers that prepare MINDORY_HOME staging, verify bundle checksums and launch the packaged installer.

in: Support release manifest download or local source/release bundle mode.
Verify release bundle SHA-256 before extraction.
Launch the installer CLI from a packaged bundle or local source checkout.
Add a minimal @mindory/installer CLI entrypoint for wizard launch and dry-run summary.
Add bootstrap validator coverage and docs.
out: Real signature verification beyond checksum placeholders.

acceptance_criteria: install.sh and install.ps1 exist at the repo root.
Bootstrap scripts create staging paths under MINDORY_HOME/install.
Bootstrap scripts can use a local --source path for dev/test mode.
Bootstrap scripts download a manifest/bundle when URLs are provided and verify SHA-256.
Bootstrap scripts launch the installer CLI without storing secrets in repo files.
Bootstrap validator checks script structure and POSIX syntax.

manual_checks: Confirm no recovery/resume implementation is included.

risks: Bootstrap scripts must fail clearly when required host tools are missing.
Checksum verification must happen before extraction.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
